title: Model-First Visual Generation

canonical_doctrine.rule: A generated image is a view of a retained scene, not the terminal artifact.

availability.meaning: The doctrine is durable, but a new assistant session does not receive the runtime merely by loading canonical memory.
must_not_claim: Do not claim model-first completion after only generating or editing a flat image.
Do not claim that canonical memory grants access to SceneForge, AvatarForge, prior container files, or prior session artifacts.
Do not claim cross-session executable availability without a successful runtime discovery and execution receipt.

entrypoints.boundary: This entrypoint retains an image as a modeled scene surface with named geometry, camera, lights, and animation. It is not the complete unrestricted SceneForge runtime.

The richer character, recovery, motion, speech, textile, and scene pipeline has implementation evidence, but it is not installed as a universal ChatGPT tool or automatically materialized into new sessions.

session_requirements: Retrieve this manifest before claiming capability availability.
Confirm a usable execution environment and materialize the named first-party source.
Write the retained scene or model before producing the accepted final render.
Reopen and validate the persisted asset.
Produce a hash-linked receipt and at least one motion, alternate-view, or interactive derivative for a full model-first claim.

minimum_model_first: persistent model or scene exists before final render
render provenance resolves to the persisted asset

fallback_policy.flat_image: A flat image may be delivered only as an explicitly labeled lightweight result or source/reference stage.
fallback_policy.missing_runtime: State that the executable runtime is unavailable in the session. Do not relabel a flat image as a modeled scene.
